preamble: Affrication of the palatal stop [c] to the postalveolar affricate [tʃ] adds a fricated release and moves the closure slightly forward. It is the usual second step in velar palatalization chains (k > c > tʃ), and it is observed directly where a palatal stop phoneme exists: Albanian q /c/ merges with ç /tʃ/ for many speakers.

examples.note: The merger of the palatal stops q, gj into the palatoalveolar affricates ç, xh is especially common in Northern Gheg and spreading in Tosk.
